LanguageData.VGE_Apparel_CombatVacsuit.label: combat vacsuit
LanguageData.VGE_Apparel_CombatVacsuit.description: A heavy-duty suit of powered armor designed for combat in the vacuum of space. The multi-layered, reinforced plating offers superior protection against ballistic attacks compared to standard vacsuits. While neuro-memetic assistors partially mitigate the bulk, the suit still imposes a penalty on movement speed and manipulation, though less severe than the standard model.
LanguageData.VGE_Apparel_CombatVacsuitHelmet.label: combat vacsuit helmet
LanguageData.VGE_Apparel_CombatVacsuitHelmet.descript: A heavy-duty, reinforced helmet for the combat vacsuit. It features layered plasteel-weave armor, a built-in status computer, and superior protection. Efficiently recycling oxygen, it permits extended vacuum operation, though periodic repressurization is required.
